wholePhysicalScope: The current 13-corner roof outline controls the building envelope. 2024 native LINZ 1 m surface samples constrain the shallow rising main roof, the lower eastern bay, and the southern roof transition.
lodDetails: The shelter footprint, rail-facing opening, shed roof, nameboard, bench and platform remain present at all levels. Close views add bench slats, sign lettering and fasteners.
limitations: The mapped footprint and sampled 2024 bare-ground and roof elevations constrain the overall profile. The location of the entrance, spacing of wall openings, southern threshold details and finish distribution are approximate.
The model uses the original Terrarium review terrain. The independent LINZ numbers constrain the roof skin and grade rise.
